Prepare RNA Expression Data as SummarizedExperiment

Source: R/variable_screening.R
prepare_RNA.Rd

Processes RNA expression data (e.g., mRNA or miRNA) by aligning samples with clinical data, removing features with low expression, and optionally performing supervised, unsupervised, or biological variable screening.

Usage

prepare_RNA(
  RNA_data,
  clinical_data,
  q_threshold = 0.25,
  method = NULL,
  cncv = FALSE,
  k_outer = 5,
  k_inner = 5,
  fallback_freq_threshold = 0.8,
  supervised_method = c("pval", "absmg", "padj", "mgpval"),
  unsupervised_method = c("A", "MAD", "laplacian"),
  p_threshold = 0.05,
  hvg_threshold = 25,
  top_n_features = NULL,
  gene_list = NULL,
  n_neighbors = NULL,
  cv_seed = 4820
)

Arguments

RNA_data

Numeric matrix of RNA expression data (features as rows, samples as columns). Features may represent mRNAs, miRNAs, or other transcriptomic measurements.

clinical_data

Matrix or data frame of clinical data (variables as rows, samples as columns). Must include "overall_survival" and "status" rows for supervised selection.

q_threshold

Numeric quantile threshold (0-1) for low-expression filtering. Features with expression at this quantile equal to 0 are removed. Default is 0.25.

method

Character string for variable screening: "supervised", "unsupervised", "biological", or NULL (no selection). Default is NULL.

cncv

Logical. If TRUE, feature screening is performed with consensus nested cross-validation (cnCV; Parvandeh et al., 2020, Bioinformatics, doi:10.1093/bioinformatics/btaa046) instead of a single pass on the full data. Two nested levels of resampling are used (outer / inner folds); the screening is run only on inner-training data and the consensus is taken first across inner folds, then across outer folds. Predictive performance is never used to choose features. Requires the caret package. Default is FALSE.

k_outer

Integer. Number of outer folds (only used if cncv = TRUE). Default is 5.

k_inner

Integer. Number of inner folds, created within each outer training fold (only used if cncv = TRUE). Default is 5.

fallback_freq_threshold

Numeric in (0, 1]. Minimum fraction of sets a feature must appear in when the strict-intersection consensus is empty at a given nesting level (only used if cncv = TRUE). Default is 0.8.

supervised_method

Character string specifying the supervised screening criterion, passed to supervised_screening:

  • "pval": p-value of the marginal Cox test. Supports p_threshold and top_n_features.

  • "padj": Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value. Supports p_threshold and top_n_features.

  • "absmg": absolute marginal Cox coefficient \(|\hat\beta_j|\). Requires top_n_features.

  • "mgpval": combined score \(-\log_{10}(p)\times|\hat\beta_j|\). Requires top_n_features.

Default is "pval".

unsupervised_method

Character string specifying the unsupervised screening method:

  • "A": coefficient of variation.

  • "MAD": median absolute deviation.

  • "laplacian": Laplacian score.

Default is "A".

p_threshold

Numeric p-value threshold for supervised selection. Used only when supervised_method is "pval" or "padj" and top_n_features is NULL. Default is 0.05.

hvg_threshold

Numeric percentile (0-100) for highly variable feature selection in unsupervised methods. Used only when top_n_features is NULL. Default is 25 (top 25% most variable features).

top_n_features

Integer. If provided, overrides threshold-based filtering. Mandatory when supervised_method is "absmg" or "mgpval". Default is NULL.

gene_list

Character vector of feature names to retain. Used only when method = "biological". Features may correspond to genes, miRNAs, or other transcriptomic entities. Default is NULL.

n_neighbors

Integer. Number of neighbors for Laplacian score computation (unsupervised_method = "laplacian"). Recommended to tune based on sample size, approximately \(\sqrt{n}\). Default is NULL.

cv_seed

Integer. Seed for fold assignment (only used if cncv = TRUE). Default is 4820.

Value

A SummarizedExperiment object containing:

  • assays$counts: Filtered RNA expression matrix.

  • metadata$preprocessing: A list containing:

    • omics: Omics type. Always "RNA" (covers mRNA, miRNA, and other transcriptomic measurements).

    • method: Screening method applied.

    • sub_method: Specific screening criterion used.

    • n_features: Number of retained features.

  • metadata$preprocessing$cncv: TRUE/FALSE. When TRUE, the list also contains k_outer, k_inner, fallback_freq_threshold, final_mode_used ("intersect" or "frequency_fallback" at the final outer consensus level), per_outer_consensus and per_outer_mode_used.
